provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^341 - 1 with a(x) = x^30 + x^54 + x^112 + x^135 + x^138 + x^139 + x^141 + x^173 + x^177 + x^180 + x^207 + x^247, b(x) = x^12 + x^25 + x^40 + x^59 + x^72 + x^85 + x^96 + x^103 + x^164 + x^171 + x^284 + x^333; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T]. a and b are low-weight codewords of the ideal of a divisor of x^341 - 1 of degree 31, fixing k = 2 deg gcd(a, b, x^m - 1) = 62.
provenance.notes: Designed-divisor construction: the divisor is a product of cyclotomic-coset minimal polynomials over GF(2^ord_2(m)), so its degree and hence k are chosen rather than inherited, and a and b are drawn from its ideal by information-set decoding. Distance is a witness-backed upper bound from 24 random information-set seeds at 2,000,000 trials each; both witnesses re-verified against these matrices.
